conclusion: The public ACC Football renderer supports freezing a strict source-derived name/status parser and exact Initial/Game Day publication-phase allowlist now. It does not expose a separate completed flag, canonical player identity, unknown phase aliases, or an all-available declaration for empty arrays.

evidence.meaning: The ACC Football renderer is Ze, not the generic or other-conference renderer.

evidence.meaning: Exact Initial and Report Pending phase branches; later fallback is presentation, not a phase enum.
Exact Game Day branch. A preceding Wednesday-date presentation branch can override the heading; parse raw ReportType.
Full-game Out and first-half suspension share the displayed OUT heading; preserve raw distinction.
Source none-to-report condition needs a nonempty row array and no non-Available statuses.
Guard on the none-to-report message; empty arrays do not satisfy it.
Exact displayed team declaration under the preceding guard.
Only explicitly recognized category statuses are displayed; unknown non-Available values can disappear.
The renderer prints the raw name and does not join a player ID or jersey.
React row key is its positional index, not a stable athlete key.
Display says expected iff Pending; all other strings say posted. No backend completion bit is checked.
Two presented team blocks, with no canonical home/away inference.
UI display limit only; not proof the endpoint contains at most 18 reports.
The ACC football formatter appends ET to source time; it does not establish publication or perform a verified venue-time conversion.

policy.page_3: Both teams are published together after the reporting deadline; nonconference reporting is optional.
policy.pages_1_2: Named availability statuses, full-game versus first-half Out, unlisted-player presumed Available and explicit Available when a previously listed player recovers.

proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.QB_matching: Selected research rule, not a publisher guarantee: exact team-and-season-scoped full name after NFKD -> ASCII -> lowercase -> alphanumeric normalization, preserving raw names and all tokens/suffixes. Canonical collisions remain ambiguous; no fuzzy/prefix match, initials expansion, suffix dropping or jersey-only substitution. Supersedes the earlier uncommitted NFKC proposal.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.basis: Renderer source plus official policy; distinguish operational source-posted classification from independent backend completeness certification.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.empty_team_array: Unknown; do not infer all available.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.first_half: Retain separately; do not merge into full-game Out even though the UI heading does.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.full_game_Out_mapping_failure: Unknown burden; do not silently discard an unresolved Out row.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.nonempty_mixed_team_rows: Interpret recognized explicit statuses under the known posted phase. The policy supplies the unlisted-player presumption only for an applicable report, not for pending/missing/invalid input.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.pending_or_unknown_phase: Not a usable source-posted study phase. Preserve raw record and reason.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.publication_phase_validation: First real responses must satisfy the already frozen predicates; no discretionary requirement for another schema review solely because they are populated.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.row_schema: Require arrays and string status; require nonempty name for player-specific interpretation. Reject/preserve malformed or unknown categories rather than silently dropping them.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.team_none: Known posted phase AND nonempty all-Available rows supports the explicit team none declaration without guessing a placeholder player identity.
proposed_strict_parser_design_not_active.timing: Use actual original source receipt; issue labels/deadlines/cache metadata are separate.

residual_limits: Renderer source defines presentation and field use, not a general backend data schema or exhaustive guarantee of submission completeness.
Unknown nonpending ReportType values must not be treated as completed simply because the renderer prints posted.
No canonical player ID or jersey field is established by this component. Name format, duplicate/placeholder cases and roster matching can fail on future actual records; preserve unavailable states.
An Available-only row could be a display placeholder; the source does not establish its player identity. The explicit team none predicate is the supported meaning.
The source does not verify both teams ACC membership; a separate conference-eligibility source/rule is needed if a study excludes optional nonconference reports.
Source can change. Preserve this source hash and original response before any parser revision; do not retroactively manufacture decision-time forecasts.

separate_official_conference_evidence.scope: Only this current matchup verified; future official inputs require the same conjoined checks. No target outcome inspected.
separate_official_conference_evidence.source: ESPN original scoreboard inventory, distinct from ACC renderer

verified_renderer_contract.conference_membership_evidence: ACC route/request establishes report organization, not that both teams are ACC conference members.
verified_renderer_contract.player_matching_or_normalization: None in this ACC Football component; names are emitted as supplied.
verified_renderer_contract.posted_label_predicate: ReportType != Report Pending (display behavior only; not recommended as an unrestricted eligibility predicate)
verified_renderer_contract.stable_row_key: None; positional index used for rendering.
verified_renderer_contract.team_none_to_report_predicate: rows is nonempty and every row.status == Available
verified_renderer_contract.unknown_status_behavior: Can be invisible because it fails the fixed category filters; must remain unknown in a research parser.
